card.name: Error reporting in programming manuals
card.fires_on: Words in software manual pages about errors, exit status and errno, such as the dash before 'An error occurred' or verbs like 'return', 'determine' and 'notifies' that lead into error or data-change reports.

modes.label: Exit and error codes
modes.description: Entries listing exit values or errno names and their meanings in Unix-style manual pages.
